contexts.text: Tacit respiration (of Swedenborg).
The Angels who sat at the head were very silent.
They did not speak, except silently.
The man of the Most Ancient Church had no external respiration except a tacit one.
Their speech was silent. AC 7361.
How their internal respiration inflowed tacitly into a kind of external one, and thus into silent speech.
Bends by a silent Providence.
Jacob was silent until they came () = consultation from the truths of faith which belonged to him... To be silent = to think and consult silently.
(Silent Spirits of the peritoneum.) SE 989.
Angelic influx is silent, imperceptible. AC 6205.
Genii... pervert so secretly and silently... They place their delight in being silent.
Speech (in Mars) is almost silent.
Ye shall be silent () = that they shall effect nothing by their own strength. To be silent = to acquiesce.
Supplication from the heart, even if silent, is heard in Heaven as a cry.
The internal respiration is tacit.
Leading man so silently... DP 186.
Therefore when a man thinks tacitly, he breathes tacitly.
The respiration of the spirit is so tacit that it is not perceived.
Meditation falls into the... tacit thought of the body.
The Divine Providence takes away this evil silently.
These sometimes receive an answer by... a silent speech in the thought.
Women (then) are silent, and only listen.
On those who want to speak silently, as if into the ear. SE 2371.
The speech of the deceitful is silent.
Spirits far from me hear and perceive better when I am thinking silently.
From the fact that they are silent... they derive the fact that they are invisible.
I have often spoken with Angels by a silent speech of ideas.
Tacent, occurs.
